reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing 41-minute chat-hold placement seen on live Core 2026-11-22
reason: Placing 70 chat holds kept the project's work-lane command running 41 minutes and every GET of the hold timed out. Root cause (validated by an independent subagent from the live timestamps): place_chats and every read (view, chat_view) ran tick(), which stopped each covered turn one after another under the project's asyncio lock, and each stop waits for the turn's in-flight step and subagents to unwind; each hold also re-read all running goals, active turns and chat lineage. Fix: placement, release and reads tick with stop=False (statuses and goal pauses only); the periodic tick_all starts each project's pass as a background task (never twice) so the chat schedule loop does not wait; a pass reads goals/turns once, shares lineage across holds, and stops due turns concurrently (8 at a time) outside the lock, recording outcomes per hold. Selected: the chat-hold and project-hold suites, including two new regressions that fail on origin/main (placement stopped a turn; the pass timed out on the lock).
exclusions: No UI change. tests/test_simulation_host_restart.py::test_host_switch_bounds_a_supervisor_that_never_finishes_its_stop and ::test_host_switch_frees_an_orphan_left_by_a_stop_timeout fail identically on origin/main 045b09d (deployer script, does not import project_holds). Not LAN- or live-verified.
